summary: Flat kerb beside golf course trees, homes 24-30 m across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Tree belt and golf course on the kerb side; nearest dwellings 24-30 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open public street; trees run to the kerb edge so pull-over room is unclear, one or two cars seem parked at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Wide through street linking to a junction; moderate traffic likely.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit signs Mon-Fri 7am-6pm; little visible parking along this stretch.

flags: Flat at the best section, about 0.5% grade
Low-lying: 8.8-9.0 m, Sandy Creek 138 m away
Steep further along: up to 22% near the far end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the south side; shaded most of the day, open golf course beyond.
cannot_judge: Kerb height and verge width under trees

best_section.where: South kerb on the flat stretch below the golf course trees, opposite the mid-street homes
